scope: Independent source and actual evidence review; no runtime execution

finding.sourceDefect: Receipt reader uses docker cp against /run, explicitly mounted tmpfs. Official documented corner case excludes tmpfs copying.
finding.historicalLimit: No preflight or regression bytes and no raw copy error retained. Guest execution/confinement/systemd outcome remains unknown; running/OOM=false does not distinguish success from the boot failure sleep.

repairRequirements: Use one reviewed bounded public receipt transport; do not repeat the existing cp path.
Any guest exec reader must wait for a source-bound barrier proving the PID1-only cgroup inspection has completed; time delay alone is insufficient.
Preserve original confinement limits and production capture/classifier; no privileged fallback.
Publish complete bounded records atomically, distinguish unavailable/failed/malformed receipt, and independently complete owned cleanup on every path.
Add meaningful controlled tests for pre-barrier no-reader, failure/no-start, malformed/oversize/partial receipt and cleanup.
disposition: Actual failure and positive cleanup accepted as evidence. Source repair and controlled checks eligible for preparation; no unchanged retry, new execution grant or native qualification.
